      "path": "src/everos/infra/persistence/sqlite/_repos/session_purge.py",
      "content": "\"\"\"Delete one session's conversation state, in one transaction.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom sqlalchemy import delete, select, update\n\nfrom everos.infra.persistence.sqlite._base.repository import RepoBase\nfrom everos.infra.persistence.sqlite._base.session import session_scope\n\nfrom .._tables import ConversationStatus, Memcell, MemorizeInbox, UnprocessedBuffer\n\n\nclass SessionPurgeRepo(RepoBase[Memcell]):\n    \"\"\"Everything a session left in ``system.db`` before extraction.\n\n    Deletes its memcells, its unprocessed buffer (every track, the\n    quarantine one included) and its conversation status, and blanks the\n    request body of its failed ``memorize_inbox`` rows. Queued, processing\n    and succeeded inbox rows are left as they are: a deletion only runs once\n    none of the first two exist, and a succeeded row's body is already gone.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    model = Memcell\n\n    async def purge(\n        self, *, app_id: str, project_id: str, session_id: str\n    ) -> list[Memcell]:\n        \"\"\"Delete the session's rows; return its memcells as they were.\"\"\"\n        async with session_scope(self._factory) as s:\n            memcells = list(\n                (\n                    await s.execute(\n                        select(Memcell)\n                        .where(Memcell.app_id == app_id)\n                        .where(Memcell.project_id == project_id)\n                        .where(Memcell.session_id == session_id)\n                    )\n                )\n                .scalars()\n                .all()\n            )\n            for table in (Memcell, UnprocessedBuffer, ConversationStatus):\n                await s.execute(\n                    delete(table)\n                    .where(table.app_id == app_id)\n                    .where(table.project_id == project_id)\n                    .where(table.session_id == session_id)\n                )\n            await s.execute(\n                update(MemorizeInbox)\n                .where(MemorizeInbox.app_id == app_id)\n                .where(MemorizeInbox.project_id == project_id)\n                .where(MemorizeInbox.session_id == session_id)\n                .where(MemorizeInbox.status == \"failed\")\n                .values(payload_json=\"\")\n            )\n            await s.commit()\n        return memcells\n"
    },
    {
      "path": "src/everos/memory/extract/boundary/detection.py",
      "content": "\"\"\"Boundary detection: the session buffer cut into memcells.\n\nOwns the buffer / merge / boundary / tail sequence so the same cells feed\nthe user-memory pipeline and, in agent mode, the agent-memory pipeline. It\nalso owns the ``memcell`` ledger: each cell gets exactly one row, whatever\nthe mode, and both pipelines reference that row's ``memcell_id``.\n\nBoth modes run :func:`everalgo.boundary.adetect_boundaries` over one buffer\ntrack. Chat mode first drops tool rows; agent mode keeps them, and the\nalgorithm keeps them in the cells without showing them to the model.\nSwitching mode needs a fresh process (``settings.memorize.mode``).\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\n__all__ = [\"BoundaryDetection\", \"BoundaryOutcome\", \"Status\"]\n\nimport asyncio\nimport uuid\nfrom collections.abc import Sequence\nfrom typing import Literal, NamedTuple\n\nfrom everalgo.boundary import DetectionResult, adetect_boundaries\nfrom everalgo.llm import LLMClient, LLMOutputError\nfrom everalgo.types import MemCell\n\nfrom everos.config import BoundaryDetectionSettings\nfrom everos.core.observability.logging import get_logger\nfrom everos.core.observability.tracing import memory_span\nfrom everos.core.utils.datetime import from_timestamp\nfrom everos.memory.custom_instructions import CustomInstructions\nfrom everos.memory.extract.llm_retry import retry_llm_output\nfrom everos.memory.models import CanonicalMessage, IngestResult, MemcellRecord\nfrom everos.memory.ports import MemcellStore, SessionBufferStore, SessionKey\n\nfrom .messages import (\n    Mode,\n    close_complete_tail,\n    filter_for_mode,\n    merge_dedupe_sort,\n    slice_tail,\n    split_message_ids,\n    to_conversation_item,\n    unique_senders,\n)\nfrom .quarantine import SessionQuarantine\n\nlogger = get_logger(__name__)\n\ntype Status = Literal[\"accumulated\", \"extracted\", \"skipped\"]\n\n_RAW_TYPE_BY_MODE: dict[Mode, str] = {\n    \"chat\": \"Conversation\",\n    \"agent\": \"AgentTrajectory\",\n}\n\n\nclass BoundaryOutcome(NamedTuple):\n    \"\"\"What one call produced; the lists are parallel, index ``i`` is cell ``i``.\n\n    Attributes:\n        cells: The memcells cut this call.\n        memcell_ids: Their ids, minted here and shared by both pipelines.\n        per_cell_message_ids: The buffered message ids each cell consumed.\n        per_cell_all_senders: Each cell's distinct senders, first-seen order.\n        status: ``extracted`` when cells were cut, ``accumulated`` when the\n            messages wait in the buffer, ``skipped`` when there was nothing\n            to do or no model to ask.\n        message_count: Fresh rows this call contributed (after the mode filter).\n        tail_complete: The model's verdict that the uncut tail is already a\n            complete episode; ``None`` when no model judged it. ``True`` on a\n            non-final call has already closed the tail into the last cell.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    cells: list[MemCell]\n    memcell_ids: list[str]\n    per_cell_message_ids: list[list[str]]\n    per_cell_all_senders: list[list[str]]\n    status: Status\n    message_count: int\n    tail_complete: bool | None = None\n\n\nclass BoundaryDetection:\n    \"\"\"Cut a session's buffered messages into memcells.\n\n    Args:\n        llm: Boundary-detection model; ``None`` leaves messages buffered.\n        instructions: Custom instructions for the boundary operator.\n        session_buffer: The per-session buffer of uncut messages.\n        memcells: The memcell ledger.\n        limits: Token / message counts past which cells are cut without the\n            model.\n        attempt_timeout: Seconds one model attempt may take; ``None`` for no\n            bound. It runs before any write, so a timeout changes nothing.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        *,\n        llm: LLMClient,\n        instructions: CustomInstructions,\n        session_buffer: SessionBufferStore,\n        memcells: MemcellStore,\n        limits: BoundaryDetectionSettings,\n        attempt_timeout: float | None = None,\n    ) -> None:\n        self._llm = llm\n        self._instructions = instructions\n        self._session_buffer = session_buffer\n        self._memcells = memcells\n        self._limits = limits\n        self._attempt_timeout = attempt_timeout\n        self._quarantine = SessionQuarantine(session_buffer)\n\n    async def buffer(self, ingested: IngestResult, *, mode: Mode) -> BoundaryOutcome:\n        \"\"\"Merge fresh messages into the session buffer without asking the model.\n\n        The low-cost half of a deferred add: a later flush cuts the buffer.\n        \"\"\"\n        fresh = filter_for_mode(ingested.messages, mode)\n        if not fresh:\n            return _empty_outcome(\"skipped\", message_count=0)\n        session = _session_of(ingested)\n        merged = merge_dedupe_sort(await self._session_buffer.list(session), fresh)\n        await self._keep_buffered(session, merged)\n        return _empty_outcome(\"accumulated\", message_count=len(fresh))\n\n    async def detect(\n        self, ingested: IngestResult, *, mode: Mode, is_final: bool\n    ) -> BoundaryOutcome:\n        \"\"\"Cut the buffer plus fresh messages into cells and keep the tail.\n\n        A tail the model judges complete is closed into a last cell at once;\n        one it does not waits for the next batch or the flush.\n\n        Args:\n            ingested: This call's messages.\n            mode: ``chat`` or ``agent``.\n            is_final: Flush: the algorithm closes the trailing segment too.\n\n        Raises:\n            LLMOutputError: Every attempt got an unusable reply (below the\n                quarantine limit); nothing was written.\n            ValueError: A message the operator refuses or a row that maps to\n                no conversation item (below the quarantine limit); not retried.\n            SessionBufferQuarantinedError: This failure reached the limit and\n                the buffer was set aside.\n            TimeoutError: A model attempt ran past ``attempt_timeout``.\n        \"\"\"\n        session = _session_of(ingested)\n        fresh = filter_for_mode(ingested.messages, mode)\n        if not fresh and not is_final:\n            return _empty_outcome(\"skipped\", message_count=0)\n        buffered = await self._session_buffer.list(session)\n        merged = merge_dedupe_sort(buffered, fresh)\n        if not merged:\n            return _empty_outcome(\"accumulated\", message_count=0)\n        if not is_final and not any(m.role == \"user\" for m in merged):\n            # Episode extraction needs a user message; wait for one.\n            await self._keep_buffered(session, merged)\n            return _empty_outcome(\"accumulated\", message_count=len(fresh))\n        result = await self._segment_or_quarantine(\n            session, merged, buffered=buffered, mode=mode, is_final=is_final\n        )\n        result = self._close_complete_tail(session, result, is_final=is_final)\n        if not result.cells:\n            await self._keep_buffered(session, merged)\n            return _empty_outcome(\n                \"accumulated\",\n                message_count=len(fresh),\n                tail_complete=result.tail_complete,\n            )\n        return await self._commit_cells(\n            session, merged, result, mode=mode, message_count=len(fresh)\n        )\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _close_complete_tail(\n        session: SessionKey, result: DetectionResult, *, is_final: bool\n    ) -> DetectionResult:\n        closed = close_complete_tail(result, is_final=is_final)\n        if closed is not result:\n            logger.info(\n                \"boundary_tail_closed\",\n                session_id=session.session_id,\n                items=len(result.tail),\n            )\n        return closed\n\n    async def _segment_or_quarantine(\n        self,\n        session: SessionKey,\n        merged: list[CanonicalMessage],\n        *,\n        buffered: Sequence[CanonicalMessage],\n        mode: Mode,\n        is_final: bool,\n    ) -> DetectionResult:\n        \"\"\"Segment ``merged``, counting a poisoned outcome towards the quarantine.\n\n        Three outcomes say the session's input itself is bad and the next\n        call would hit it again: an unusable reply on every attempt\n        (``LLMOutputError``), a message the operator refuses (everalgo's\n        ``InvalidInputError``, a ``ValueError``) and a row that maps to no\n        conversation item (``ValueError``). Only the first is retried. Any\n        other error is infrastructure and propagates uncounted.\n        \"\"\"\n        try:\n            result = await self._segment(merged, mode=mode, is_final=is_final)\n        except (LLMOutputError, ValueError):\n            buffered_ids = {m.message_id for m in buffered}\n            unsaved = [m for m in merged if m.message_id not in buffered_ids]\n            await self._quarantine.record_failure(session, unsaved)\n            raise\n        self._quarantine.reset(session)\n        return result\n\n    async def _segment(\n        self, merged: list[CanonicalMessage], *, mode: Mode, is_final: bool\n    ) -> DetectionResult:\n        \"\"\"One bounded-retry boundary call; each attempt has its own deadline.\"\"\"\n        llm = self._llm\n        items = [to_conversation_item(m) for m in merged]\n        custom_instructions = self._instructions.load(\"boundary_detection\")\n\n        async def attempt() -> DetectionResult:\n            async with asyncio.timeout(self._attempt_timeout):\n                return await adetect_boundaries(\n                    items,\n                    llm=llm,\n                    is_final=is_final,\n                    custom_instructions=custom_instructions,\n                    hard_token_limit=self._limits.hard_token_limit,\n                    hard_msg_limit=self._limits.hard_msg_limit,\n                )\n\n        # A generation span, so the call's token usage is costed (a span-typed\n        # observation's usage is dropped).\n        with memory_span(\"everos.memcell.boundary\", observation_type=\"generation\"):\n            return await retry_llm_output(attempt, operator=\"boundary\", mode=mode)\n\n    async def _commit_cells(\n        self,\n        session: SessionKey,\n        merged: list[CanonicalMessage],\n        result: DetectionResult,\n        *,\n        mode: Mode,\n        message_count: int,\n    ) -> BoundaryOutcome:\n        \"\"\"Record one memcell row per cell, then keep only the tail buffered.\"\"\"\n        memcell_ids = [_mint_memcell_id() for _ in result.cells]\n        message_ids = split_message_ids(merged, result.cells)\n        senders = [unique_senders(cell) for cell in result.cells]\n        raw_type = _RAW_TYPE_BY_MODE[mode]\n        await self._memcells.insert_many(\n            session,\n            [\n                MemcellRecord(\n                    memcell_id=memcell_id,\n                    cell=cell,\n                    raw_type=raw_type,\n                    message_ids=ids,\n                    sender_ids=cell_senders,\n                )\n                for memcell_id, cell, ids, cell_senders in zip(\n                    memcell_ids, result.cells, message_ids, senders, strict=True\n                )\n            ],\n        )\n        last_cell_ts = max(cell.timestamp for cell in result.cells)\n        if last_cell_ts:\n            await self._session_buffer.touch_last_memcell(\n                session, from_timestamp(last_cell_ts)\n            )\n        await self._session_buffer.replace(session, slice_tail(merged, result.tail))\n        return BoundaryOutcome(\n            cells=list(result.cells),\n            memcell_ids=memcell_ids,\n            per_cell_message_ids=message_ids,\n            per_cell_all_senders=senders,\n            status=\"extracted\",\n            message_count=message_count,\n            tail_complete=result.tail_complete,\n        )\n\n    async def _keep_buffered(\n        self, session: SessionKey, merged: list[CanonicalMessage]\n    ) -> None:\n        await self._session_buffer.replace(session, merged)\n        await self._session_buffer.touch_last_message(\n            session, max(m.timestamp for m in merged)\n        )\n\n\ndef _session_of(ingested: IngestResult) -> SessionKey:\n    return SessionKey(\n        app_id=ingested.app_id,\n        project_id=ingested.project_id,\n        session_id=ingested.session_id,\n    )\n\n\ndef _mint_memcell_id() -> str:\n    return f\"mc_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}\"\n\n\ndef _empty_outcome(\n    status: Status, *, message_count: int, tail_complete: bool | None = None\n) -> BoundaryOutcome:\n    return BoundaryOutcome(\n        cells=[],\n        memcell_ids=[],\n        per_cell_message_ids=[],\n        per_cell_all_senders=[],\n        status=status,\n        message_count=message_count,\n        tail_complete=tail_complete,\n    )\n"
    },
    {
      "path": "src/everos/memory/extract/pipeline/agent_memory.py",
      "content": "\"\"\"Agent memory pipeline — 5A in the add_v1 flow.\n\nConsumes pre-cut cells from :mod:`everos.memory.extract.boundary` and returns\none :class:`AgentPipelineStarted` per cell so the OME\n``extract_agent_case`` strategy picks it up.\n\nNo sqlite memcell row is written here — the boundary stage owns that\nledger (one row per cell, shared across user / agent paths via the same\n``memcell_id``). No md is written here either: Episode md comes from\n:class:`UserMemoryPipeline`, AgentCase md is the OME strategy's job.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom everos.memory.events import AgentPipelineStarted\nfrom everos.memory.extract.pipeline.base import CellOutcome, PreparedCell\nfrom everos.memory.models import IngestResult\n\n\nclass AgentMemoryPipeline:\n    \"\"\"Announce each cell to the agent-side strategies.\"\"\"\n\n    async def run_cell(\n        self, ingested: IngestResult, prepared: PreparedCell\n    ) -> CellOutcome:\n        \"\"\"Return the cell's ``AgentPipelineStarted``.\"\"\"\n        return CellOutcome(\n            message_count=len(prepared.cell.items),\n            events=[\n                AgentPipelineStarted(\n                    memcell_id=prepared.memcell_id,\n                    session_id=ingested.session_id,\n                    app_id=ingested.app_id,\n                    project_id=ingested.project_id,\n                    memcell=prepared.cell,\n                )\n            ],\n        )\n"
    },
    {
      "path": "src/everos/memory/extract/pipeline/user_memory.py",
      "content": "\"\"\"User memory pipeline — per-sender Episode fan-out on pre-cut cells.\n\nCells / memcell_ids / message_id-mapping / sender lists are produced by\n:mod:`everos.memory.extract.boundary` (which also writes the single\n``memcell`` sqlite row per cell). This pipeline only handles the\nuser-perspective output of one cell: Episode md, plus the\n``UserPipelineStarted`` and ``EpisodeExtracted`` events that announce it.\n\n``MemoryService.add`` runs it cell by cell alongside\n:class:`AgentMemoryPipeline` (the latter only in ``mode=\"agent\"``) and\npublishes each cell's events as soon as the cell is done.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import TYPE_CHECKING\n\nfrom everalgo.types import Episode as AlgoEpisode\nfrom everalgo.types import MemCell as AlgoMemCell\nfrom everalgo.user_memory import EpisodeExtractor\n\nfrom everos.core.observability.tracing import capture_output, memory_span\nfrom everos.core.utils.language import detect_output_language\nfrom everos.memory.custom_instructions import CustomInstructions\nfrom everos.memory.events import EpisodeExtracted, UserPipelineStarted\nfrom everos.memory.extract.llm_retry import retry_llm_output\nfrom everos.memory.extract.pipeline.base import CellOutcome, PreparedCell\nfrom everos.memory.models import Episode, IngestResult\nfrom everos.memory.ports import EpisodeStore, Event, MemcellStore, MemoryRef, Scope\n\nif TYPE_CHECKING:\n    from everalgo.llm import LLMClient\n\n\nclass UserMemoryPipeline:\n    \"\"\"Per-sender Episode extraction, one pre-cut MemCell at a time.\n\n    Args:\n        episode_store: Where extracted episodes are written.\n        memcell_store: Whether the cell still exists when its episodes are\n            written (a session deletion removes it first).\n        instructions: Custom instructions for the episode operator.\n        llm_client: LLM for extraction.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        episode_store: EpisodeStore,\n        memcell_store: MemcellStore,\n        instructions: CustomInstructions,\n        llm_client: LLMClient,\n    ) -> None:\n        self._ep_ext = EpisodeExtractor(llm=llm_client)\n        self._episode_store = episode_store\n        self._memcell_store = memcell_store\n        self._instructions = instructions\n\n    async def run_cell(\n        self, ingested: IngestResult, prepared: PreparedCell\n    ) -> CellOutcome:\n        \"\"\"Extract the cell's Episode, write one copy per user sender.\n\n        The returned events start with the cell's ``UserPipelineStarted`` so\n        the strategies that consume the MemCell directly (atomic_fact /\n        foresight / clustering) are published first, followed by one\n        ``EpisodeExtracted`` per written episode.\n        \"\"\"\n        cell, memcell_id = prepared.cell, prepared.memcell_id\n        events: list[Event] = [\n            UserPipelineStarted(\n                memcell_id=memcell_id,\n                session_id=ingested.session_id,\n                app_id=ingested.app_id,\n                project_id=ingested.project_id,\n                memcell=cell,\n            )\n        ]\n        md_paths: list[str] = []\n        user_senders = _unique_user_senders(cell)\n        if user_senders:\n            algo_ep = await self._extract(ingested, prepared)\n            # The model writes in the conversation's language; what it chose\n            # pins every extraction downstream of this episode.\n            language = detect_output_language(algo_ep.episode)\n            for sender_id in user_senders:\n                ep = Episode.from_algo(\n                    algo_ep,\n                    owner_id=sender_id,\n                    session_id=ingested.session_id,\n                    sender_ids=list(prepared.sender_ids),\n                    parent_id=memcell_id,\n                    language=language,\n                )\n                ref = await self._persist(ingested, ep, memcell_id)\n                if ref is None:\n                    continue\n                md_paths.append(ref.md_path)\n                events.append(\n                    EpisodeExtracted(\n                        memcell_id=memcell_id,\n                        episode_entry_id=ref.entry_id,\n                        episode_text=ep.episode,\n                        episode_timestamp_ms=ep.timestamp,\n                        owner_id=ep.owner_id,\n                        session_id=ingested.session_id,\n                        app_id=ingested.app_id,\n                        project_id=ingested.project_id,\n                        source=\"pipeline\",\n                        language=language,\n                    )\n                )\n        return CellOutcome(\n            message_count=len(cell.items),\n            events=events,\n            md_paths=md_paths,\n        )\n\n    async def _extract(\n        self, ingested: IngestResult, prepared: PreparedCell\n    ) -> AlgoEpisode:\n        \"\"\"One whole-cell episode, shared by every user sender of the cell.\n\n        ``sender_id=None`` binds the episode to no user; the fan-out to one\n        copy per sender happens in markdown only, so a cell costs one call.\n        An unusable reply is tried again by :func:`retry_llm_output`.\n        \"\"\"\n        extractor = self._ep_ext\n        custom_instructions = self._instructions.load(\"episode_extract\")\n\n        async def attempt() -> AlgoEpisode:\n            return await extractor.aextract(\n                prepared.cell,\n                sender_id=None,\n                custom_instructions=custom_instructions,\n            )\n\n        with memory_span(\n            \"everos.extract\",\n            observation_type=\"generation\",\n            session_id=ingested.session_id,\n            metadata={\n                \"app_id\": ingested.app_id,\n                \"project_id\": ingested.project_id,\n                \"memcell_id\": prepared.memcell_id,\n            },\n        ) as extract_span:\n            # The LLM client records token usage onto this span.\n            algo_ep = await retry_llm_output(\n                attempt, operator=\"episode\", memcell_id=prepared.memcell_id\n            )\n            capture_output(extract_span, algo_ep.episode)\n \"\"\"BM25 recall via OR-mode BooleanQuery.\n\n        Each tokenised term becomes a ``SHOULD`` clause so a single\n        IDF≈0 token (typically the partition owner's own name on\n        owner-scoped corpora) cannot poison the entire query.\n        Mirrors enterprise's ``bool.should + minimum_should_match=1``\n        ES design.\n        \"\"\"\n        terms = [term for term in from_hits(hits, source=\"keyword\")\n\n    async def dense_recall(\n        self, vector: Sequence[float], where: Filter, *, limit: int\n    ) -> RecallResult[Episode]:\n        if not vector:\n            return RecallResult.empty()\n        hits = await self._index.dense_search(vector, where, limit=limit)\n        return from_hits(hits, source=\"vector\")\n\n    async def    return _as_children(await self.sparse_recall(query, where, limit=limit))\n\n    async def dense_recall_as_child(\n        self, vector: Sequence[float], where: Filter, *, limit: int\n    ) -> RecallResult[Episode]:\n        \"\"\"Dense recall (body vector ANN) returning as MaxSim children.\"\"\"\n        return _as_children(await self.dense_recall(vector, where, limit=limit))\n\n    async def dense_recall_subject(\n        self, vector: Sequence[float], where: Filter, *, limit: int\n    ) -> RecallResult[Episode]:\n        \"\"\"ANN over the subject embedding; episodes without one never match.\"\"\"\n        if not vector:\n            return RecallResult.empty()\n        hits = await self._index.dense_search_subject(vector, where, limit=limit)\n        return from_hits(hits, source=\"vector\")\n\n    async def dense_recall_subject_as_child(\n        self, vector: Sequence[float], where: Filter, *, limit: int\n    ) -> RecallResult[Episode]:\n        \"\"\"Subject-vector ANN returning as MaxSim children.\"\"\"\n        return _as_children(await self.dense_recall_subject(vector, where, limit=limit))\n\n    async def fetch_all_for_owner(self, where: Filter) -> RecallResult[Episode]:\n        \"\"\"Every episode in ``where``, keyed by ``entry_id``.\n\n        Cluster membership matching in ``acluster_retrieve`` compares\n        ``Candidate.id`` against ``Cluster.members``, which are episode\n        entry ids. No ``limit``: the whole owner partition is needed.\n        \"\"\"\n        return _by_entry_id(await self._index.find(where), score=0.0)\n\n    async def fetch_parents(\n        self, entry_ids: Sequence[str], where: Filter\n    ) -> RecallResult[Episode]:\n        \"\"\"Episodes by ``entry_id``, keyed by it -- the MaxSim parent fetch.\n\n        A child's ``parent_id`` is its episode's entry id whether the episode\n        came from a memcell or a cluster merge, so parents are addressed by it.\n        \"\"\"\n        if not entry_ids:\n            return RecallResult.empty()\n not entry_ids:\n            return RecallResult.empty()\n        full_where = all_of(where, one_of(\"entry_id\", list(entry_ids)))\n        hits = await self._index.find(full_where, limit=len(entry_ids))\n        return from_hits(hits, source=\"vector\")\n\n\ndef _as_children(result: RecallResult[Episode]) -> RecallResult[Episode]:\n    \"\"\"Tag each candidate with ``parent_id = entry_id`` for MaxSim grouping.\"\"\"\n    return RecallResult(\n        candidates=[\n            c.model_copy(\n                update={\"metadata\": {**c.metadata, \"parent_id\": c.metadata[\"entry_id\"]}}\n            )\n            for c in result.candidates\n        ],\n        stored_by_id=result.stored_by_id,\n    )\n\n\ndef _by_entry_id(\n    hits:       "path": "src/everos/memory/strategies/extract_agent_case.py",
      "content": "\"\"\"extract_agent_case strategy — distil one AgentCase from an agent memcell.\n\nPer-memcell extraction: algo's :class:`AgentCaseExtractor` returns no case\ntogether with the gate that rejected the memcell (logged as\n``agent_case_skipped`` with its ``reason`` and ``detail``), or a single case.\n\n**Skip reasons are persisted**: every run that completes stamps the memcell\nthrough :meth:`MemcellStore.mark_case_extracted` -- ``skip_reason`` is\n``None`` exactly when a case came out, otherwise everalgo's\n``CaseSkipReason`` value (or ``no_agent_sender`` for EverOS's own gate below,\nnamed in the same vocabulary). A gated memcell is a successful run with no\noutput, so without the stamp its reason would exist only in a log line.\nThe most common reason in practice is everalgo's closure gate\n(``trajectory_not_closed`` / ``no_messages_after_strip``): when boundary\ndetection cuts a trajectory before the assistant's final answer, neither\nhalf is a closed task, and no case is produced -- accepted upstream\nbehaviour, made queryable here rather than patched over.\nQuality score is persisted as-is; no everos-side threshold filter\n(opensource parity — let downstream rank / filter handle it).\n\n**Correctness gate** (``[agent_memory] case_gate_enabled``, off by default):\nwith a judge in :attr:`MemoryDeps.case_judge`, everalgo admits a memcell by\nthe judged probability that its work was completed correctly instead of by\nits complexity and value filters, and the admitted case carries the\ndecision as ``case_gate``.\n\n**Multi-agent fan-out**: the algo prompt's output is third-person\n(``the agent did X``, ``a different agent lacking this insight``), so\nthe same case body is a valid reference experience for **every**\nassistant sender that participated in the trajectory. We collect all\ndistinct assistant-side sender_ids in the memcell, write the same case\nbody once per agent (each gets its own owner_id-scoped md entry), and\nreturn one ``AgentCaseExtracted`` per agent so the downstream skill\nclustering chain runs in each agent's own scope.\n\nAlgo limitation (recorded in\n``local/notes/2026-05-18-write-read-loop-status.md``): the LLM only\nsees a flat ``\"assistant\"`` role label — per-agent serialisation +\nper-agent output is a future algo-side change. Until then, broadcast\nis the right md-layer fan-out (mirrors Episode/atomic_fact).\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom everalgo.agent_memory import AgentCaseExtractor, AgentCaseGate\nfrom everalgo.types import AgentCase as AlgoAgentCase\n\nfrom everos.core.observability.logging import get_logger\nfrom everos.memory.deps import MemoryDeps\nfrom everos.memory.events import AgentCaseExtracted, AgentPipelineStarted\nfrom everos.memory.mappers import agent_case as agent_case_mapper\nfrom everos.memory.models import MemCell\nfrom everos.memory.ports import (\n    Event,\n    Immediate,\n    Scope,\n    StrategySpec,\n)\n\nlogger = get_logger(__name__)\n\n_NO_AGENT_SENDER = \"no_agent_sender\"\n\"\"\"Skip reason when the memcell has no assistant-side sender to file under.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def extract_agent_case(\n    event: AgentPipelineStarted, deps: MemoryDeps\n) -> list[Event]:\n    \"\"\"Distil one case from the memcell and file it under every agent sender.\"\"\"\n    # 1. Find the distinct assistant senders in this memcell; bail if none.\n    agent_ids = _collect_agent_ids(event.memcell)\n    if not agent_ids:\n        logger.warning(\n            \"agent_case_skipped_no_assistant\",\n            memcell_id=event.memcell_id,\n            session_id=event.session_id,\n        )\n        await deps.stores.memcell.mark_case_extracted(\n            event.memcell_id, skip_reason=_NO_AGENT_SENDER, skip_detail={}\n        )\n        return []\n\n    # 2. Run the extractor once; algo returns no case with the gate that\n    #    rejected the memcell, or a single case.\n    extractor = AgentCaseExtractor(llm=deps.llm, gate=_case_gate(deps))\n    result = await extractor.aextract_with_reason(event.memcell)\n    if not result.cases:\n        logger.info(\n            \"agent_case_skipped\",\n            memcell_id=event.memcell_id,\n            session_id=event.session_id,\n            reason=result.reason,\n            detail=result.detail,\n        )\n        await deps.stores.memcell.mark_case_extracted(\n            event.memcell_id,\n            skip_reason=str(result.reason),\n            skip_detail=result.detail,\n        )\n        return []\n\n    # 3. File the same case under every agent sender and announce each copy\n    #    → downstream trigger_skill_clustering.\n    (algo_case,) = result.cases\n    filed = [\n        await _file_case(algo_case, agent_id, event, deps) for agent_id in agent_ids\n    ]\n    extracted: list[Event] = [case for case in filed if case is not None]\n    await deps.stores.memcell.mark_case_extracted(\n        event.memcell_id, skip_reason=None, skip_detail={}\n    )\n    logger.info(\n        \"agent_case_extracted\",\n        memcell_id=event.memcell_id,\n        session_id=event.session_id,\n        owner_ids=agent_ids,\n        quality_score=algo_case.quality_score,\n        fanout=len(agent_ids),\n    )\n    return extracted\n\n\ndef _case_gate(deps: MemoryDeps) -> AgentCaseGate | None:\n    \"\"\"everalgo's correctness gate over the configured judge, if there is one.\"\"\"\n    if deps.case_judge is None:\n        return None\n    return AgentCaseGate(judge=deps.case_judge)\n\n\nasync def _file_case(\n    algo_case: AlgoAgentCase,\n    agent_id: str,\n    event: AgentPipelineStarted,\n    deps: MemoryDeps,\n) -> AgentCaseExtracted | None:\n    \"\"\"Write the case under ``agent_id`` and return its announcement.\n\n    ``None`` when the store skipped the write (its ``only_if`` failed).\n    \"\"\"\n    case = agent_case_mapper.from_algo(\n        algo_case,\n        owner_id=agent_id,\n        session_id=event.session_id,\n        parent_id=event.memcell_id,\n    )\n    scope = Scope(\n        app_id=event.app_id,\n        project_id=event.project_id,\n        owner_id=agent_id,\n        owner_type=\"agent\",\n    )\n\n    async def memcell_alive() -> bool:  # a session deletion removes it first\n        return bool(await deps.stores.memcell.find_by_ids([event.memcell_id]))\n\n    ref = await deps.stores.agent_case.append(scope, case, only_if=memcell_alive)\n    if ref is None:\n        return None\n    return AgentCaseExtracted(\n        memcell_id=event.memcell_id,\n        case_entry_id=ref.entry_id,\n        task_intent=case.task_intent,\n        approach=case.approach,\n        key_insight=case.key_insight,\n        quality_score=case.quality_score,\n        case_timestamp_ms=case.timestamp,\n        agent_id=case.owner_id,\n        app_id=event.app_id,\n        project_id=event.project_id,\n        case_gate=case.case_gate,\n    )\n\n\ndef _collect_agent_ids(memcell: MemCell) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Distinct assistant-side sender_ids in a cell, preserving first-seen order.\n\n    An \"assistant-side\" item is any ``role == 'assistant'`` ChatMessage or\n    any ``kind == 'tool_call'`` request (also assistant-emitted). The\n    deterministic order matches Episode pipeline's\n    :func:`_unique_user_senders` so two runs over the same memcell fan\n    out identically. Empty list means the cell carries no agent\n    trajectory — caller logs + skips.\n    \"\"\"\n    seen: list[str] = []\n    for item in memcell.items:\n        sid = getattr(item, \"sender_id\", None)\n        if not sid or sid in seen:\n            continue\n        if getattr(item, \"role\", None) == \"assistant\":\n            seen.append(sid)\n            continue\n        if getattr(item, \"kind\", None) == \"tool_call\":\n            seen.append(sid)\n    return seen\n\n\nEXTRACT_AGENT_CASE_SPEC = StrategySpec(\n    name=\"extract_agent_case\",\n    fn=extract_agent_case,\n    trigger=Immediate(on=[AgentPipelineStarted]),\n    emits=frozenset({AgentCaseExtracted}),\n    max_retries=2,\n)\n"
    },

      "content": "\"\"\"Application assembly: the one place EverOS's objects are built and wired.\n\n:func:`build_application` turns :class:`~everos.config.Settings` into an\n:class:`Application` -- three facades (:class:`MemoryService`,\n:class:`KnowledgeService`, :class:`OpsService`) plus the snapshot of which\noptional providers were configured. Everything below the facades is built\nhere and nowhere else: providers, storage adapters, the OME engine with every\nstrategy registered, the event bus, the cascade orchestrator, the domain\npipelines and managers. Entry points (HTTP, CLI) hold one ``Application`` and\ncall facade methods.\n\nBuilding has no side effect beyond configuring the process-wide tracing and\nmetrics backends: no file is written and no connection opened. Either way the caller ends with\n:meth:`Application.aclose`, which undoes exactly what was started and shuts\ntracing down.\n\nAn unconfigured optional provider becomes ``None``; whoever needs it decides\nwhat that means (search degrades, knowledge uploads refuse, the server's\n:meth:`~Application.start` refuses to run without an extraction LLM).\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"Application\",\n    \"Providers\",\n    \"build_application\",\n    \"build_providers\",\n    \"build_replay_engine\",\n    \"configure_process\",\n]\n\nimport Publishing is this use case's job:\npipelines and strategies return events, and each cell's are published as\nsoon as the cell is done, so a failing cell never takes an earlier cell's\nevents with it.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\n__all__ = [\"Memorizer\", \"flush_payload\"]\n\nimport asyncio\nfrom typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Literal\n\nfrom everos.core.context import resolve_request_id\nfrom everos.core.locks import LOCKS, session_key\nfrom everos.core.observability.logging import get_logger\nfrom everos.core.observability.tracing import memory_span\nfrom everos.memory.extract.ingest import process as ingest_process\nfrom everos.memory.extract.pipeline import PipelineOutcome, PreparedCell\nfrom everos.service.memory._extraction import ExtractionSupervisor\nfrom everos.service.memory._models import MemorizeResult\n\nif TYPE_CHECKING:\n    from everalgo.llm import LLMClient\n\n    from everos.component.parser import RawFileBuilder\n    from everos.config import Settings\n    from everos.memory import IngestResult\n    from everos.memory.extract.boundary import BoundaryDetection, BoundaryOutcome\n    from everos.memory.extract.pipeline import CellOutcome, Pipeline\n    from everos.memory.ports import EventBus\n\nlogger = get_logger(\"everos.service.memory\")\n\nMode = Literal[\"chat\", \"agent\"]\nTrackStatus = Literal[\"accumulated\", \"extracted\", \"skipped\"]\n\n\nclass Memorizer:\n    \"\"\"Runs memorize calls, one session at a time, over injected domain objects.\n\n    Args:\n        settings: Application settings (``[memorize]``).\n        boundary: Cuts each session's buffered messages into memcells.\n        multimodal_llm: Parses non-text content; Dispatched concurrently across pipelines.\n\n        Args:\n            payload: ``{\"session_id\", \"messages\": [...]}`` — entrypoints DTO\n                dumped to dict.\n            is_final: ``True`` only for flush (algo guarantees ``tail=[]``).\n            defer_extraction: Persist fresh messages to the unprocessed buffer\n                but skip boundary detection and both extraction pipelines.\n                Intended for clients that batch work and call ``/flush`` on\n                idle or thresholds.\n\n        Concurrency: serialised per ``(app_id, project_id, session_id)`` on\n        the ``\"session\"`` lock of :data:`everos.core.locks.LOCKS`. The lock\n        spans the read-merge-boundary-write cycle: two unserialised calls\n        would both read the same buffer rows, cut their own slice, and the\n        later buffer write would drop the earlier call's tail messages\n        (they never reached a memcell either).\n\n        ``settings.memorize.session_lock_timeout_seconds`` bounds the two\n        places a call can hang while something else waits on the lock: the\n        wait for the lock itself, and the boundary LLM call. The task is owned\n            # by the supervisor, which keeps it, retrieves its outcome and\n            # waits for it at shutdown; the request only shields it.\n            extraction = self._extractions.supervise(\n                self._extract(payload, ingested, boundary, mode=mode),\n                session_id=session_id,\n                memcell_ids=boundary.memcell_ids,\n            )\n            try:\n                return await asyncio.shield(extraction)\n            except asyncio.CancelledError:\n                logger.warning(\n                    \"memorize_extraction_continues_after_cancel\",\n                    session_id=session_id,\n                    memcell_ids=boundary.memcell_ids,\n                )\n                raise\n\n    async def _cut(\n        self,\n        payload: dict[str, Any],\n        *,\n        mode: Mode,\n        is_final: bool,\n        defer_extraction: bool,\n    ) -> MemorizeResult | tuple[IngestResult, BoundaryOutcome]:\n        \"\"\"Inner critical section — runs under the per-session lock.\n\n        Returns the result when nothing reached the boundary, or the\n        ingested batch and the boundary outcome for :meth:`_extract` to run\n        once the lock is released.\n        \"\"\"\n        ingested = await ingest_process(\n            payload,\n            multimodal_llm=self._multimodal_llm,\n            raw_file_builder=self._raw_file_builder,\n        )\n        if defer_extraction and not is_final:\n            buffered = await self._boundary.buffer(ingested, mode=mode)\n            return MemorizeResult(\n                message_count=len(payload.get(\"messages\", [])),\n                status=_merge_status(buffered.status, \"skipped\"),\n            )\n\n        boundary = await self._boundary.detect(ingested, mode=mode, is_final=is_final)\n\n        if not boundary.cells:\n            # asyncio.gather(\n                *(p.run_cell(ingested, prepared) for p in pipelines.values()),\n                return_exceptions=True,\n            )\n            for track, result in zip(pipelines, or result\n                    continue\n                outcomes[track].append(result)\n                await self._bus.publish(result.events)\n        if first_error is not None:\n            raise first_error\n\n        user = PipelineOutcome.from_cells(\"user_memory\", outcomes[\"user_memory\"])\n        agent_status: TrackStatus = (\n            PipelineOutcome.from_cells(\"agent_memory\", outcomes[\"agent_memory\"]).status\n            if mode == \"agent\"\n            else \"skipped\"\n        )\n        return MemorizeResult(\n            message_count=len(payload.get(\"messages\", [])),\n            status=_merge_status(user.status, agent_status),\n        )\n\n\ndef _prepared_cells(boundary: BoundaryOutcome) -> list[PreparedCell]:\n    return [\n        PreparedCell(cell=cell,
